display.purpose: Modal/section titles (artist, album, track headers). Used sparingly, DM Serif Display.

data.purpose: Every rank, play count, date, and data-tied control label. Always DM Mono.

body.purpose: Prose, settings labels, modal copy. DM Sans.

accent-tagline.purpose: Single italic tagline moment on the landing screen only (Instrument Serif). Not reused elsewhere.

shadows.name: badge-glow-pulse
shadows.purpose: Achievement badge signal; the one animated shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default color/border transitions on hover/focus (no scale/shadow pop).

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Main action buttons like SYNC NOW; accent-bordered, DM Mono label with inline icon glyph.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #4aacff; border: 1px solid #1e3d72; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: #2a52a0; color: #80c8ff; } .ds-btn-icon { font-size: 0.9em; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions like Configure; transparent until hovered, quiet chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a8c8f0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #1e3d72; color: #eaf2ff; }

components.name: Theme Swatch Toggle
components.description: Circular color-dot buttons for switching between the 9 color themes; active one shows a ring.
components.css: .ds-theme-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; color: #4aacff; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.6; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-theme-dot:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-theme-dot-active { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eaf2ff33; }

components.name: Period Nav Pill
components.description: Segmented pill navigation for switching chart period (week/month/year); active segment fills with accent.
components.css: .ds-period-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: #173060; border-radius: 20px; padding: 3px; } .ds-pill { background: transparent; color: #a8c8f0; border: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-pill-active { background: #4aacff; color: #08121e; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Achievement Badge
components.description: Gold pill badge for earned achievements (BU badges); pulses with an animated glow, the system's one animated shadow.
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: transparent; color: #f0aa30; border: 1px solid #f0aa30; border-radius: 20px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; animation: ds-badge-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-badge-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; border-color: #f0aa30; color: #f0aa30; } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 10px 3px #f0aa30; border-color: #fcd34d; color: #fcd34d; } }

narrative.overview: dankcharts.fm turns a listener's scrobble history into a leaderboard: ranked Songs, Artists, and Albums, backed by dense, precise numbers, and topped with collectible badges. The system is data-nerdy and playful at once — it never apologizes for showing exact play counts and rank deltas, but it also has fun with the presentation: a pulsing gold badge glow, nine swappable color themes, and a dedicated share-as-image path so a chart looks intentional the moment it's screenshotted. This explicitly rejects the generic SaaS analytics-dashboard look — flat gray cards, corporate blue, data buried under chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace numerals for anything that is a rank, count, or stat.
Soft, tactile surfaces: gentle shadows and 4-20px rounded corners.
Color theme is the personality lever — nine total themes.
Badges and share-as-image output are first-class, polished surfaces.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Theme Rule
rules.body: Each color theme carries exactly one primary accent hue. Never mix two themes' accents on screen at once.

rules.name: The Gold Means Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold is reserved for badges/achievements. If a control isn't rewarding the user, it doesn't get gold.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Any text that is a number, rank, date, or data-tied control label renders in DM Mono. DM Sans is reserved for prose.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule for Badges
rules.body: Achievement badges signal importance with an animated gold glow, not a drop shadow.

dos: Do use DM Mono for every number, rank, date, and data-tied control label.
Do keep corner radii in the 4-20px range depending on component scale.
Do use color-only feedback (border/background brightening) for hover/focus on buttons.
Do treat badges and share-as-image output as polished, screenshot-ready surfaces.
Do build every visual feature so it works identically across all nine color themes.
Do support Last.fm, Google Sheets, and CSV-upload data sources equally in any new UI.
donts: Don't use flat gray cards or corporate-blue SaaS dashboard styling.
Don't put a drop shadow on a badge; badges get the animated gold glow instead.
Don't mix DM Sans and DM Mono within the same numeric readout.
Don't hide or truncate precise stats to simplify the UI.
Don't introduce a second accent hue within one theme.
